assay: TRAP-seq (translating mRNA, Emx1-NuTRAP excitatory neurons), polyA RNA-seq, NovaSeq 100 bp PE; separate bulk RNA-seq of wild-type dorsal hippocampus for the OLM experiment

wild_type_OLM_experiment: juvenile P21-27 / adolescent P35-41 exercise 3 min OLM

sample_inclusion: SIT TRAP-seq: 4 ELE + 4 sedentary deposited; PCA outliers removed 2 sedentary and 1 ELE, leaving n = 2 sedentary and n = 3 ELE (FIG4 legend; S4.1.16.1.p2). Separate isolation: n = 3 mice per group (S4.1.7.p1, FIG2 legend f).
primary_estimand: Effect of early-life voluntary wheel running (P21-41) vs sedentary housing on translating mRNA in Emx1+ hippocampal neurons at P42, SIT isolation (S2.4.p1, FIG4a).
planned_contrasts: SIT TRAP-seq ELE vs sedentary (S2.4.p1, FIG4a; paper: 297 up, 338 down; n = 3 ELE vs 2 sed after outlier removal)
Separate-isolation TRAP-seq ELE vs sedentary (S2.2.p3, FIG2f-g; counts only in Supplementary Data 3)
Separate isolation, ELE vs sedentary within left and within right hemisphere, plus hemisphere x exercise LRT / 2-way ANOVA (S2.3.p1, S4.1.16.1.p3-p4; LRT exercise = 565, 2-way ANOVA exercise = 1583)
Wild-type bulk RNA-seq OLM experiment, each group vs sedentary no-OLM (S2.6, FIG6b)
repeated_measure_unit: mouse; in separate isolation the two hemispheres of one mouse went to TRAP and INTACT respectively (S4.1.7.p1), so RNA libraries are one per mouse
normalization: DESeq2 size factors; counts by GenomicAlignments summarizeOverlaps (S4.1.16.1.p2)
paper_method: DESeq2 1.32.0, negative binomial Wald test, ~ exercise (S4.1.16.1.p2)
